speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: Hello! I have something really important that I would like to talk to you about today.

speaker: A2H1QUGX0SOUMH
text: HI! OK, I'm curious to hear what you have to say.

speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: Great! Have you ever heard of the Save the Children Foundation?

speaker: A2H1QUGX0SOUMH
text: Not sure. Sounds familiar.

speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: Well, it is an international non-governmental organization that promotes the rights of children in war torn areas. It provides relief and helps support the children in these developing countries. Does this sound like something you could be passionate about?

speaker: A2H1QUGX0SOUMH
text: Yes, it does.

speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: It is a great organization because they use donations really well. They are able to tangibly help these kiddos. They have a huge interntional impact. What do you think about that?

speaker: A2H1QUGX0SOUMH
text: Sounds good so far.

speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: Do you have any questions about the organization?

speaker: A2H1QUGX0SOUMH
text: How long has it been around?

speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: It was founded in 1919! So its almost had a century of impact.

speaker: A2H1QUGX0SOUMH
text: Who is behind it?

speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: The people who run it are non-for profit and do it full time! You know what is really awesome though?

speaker: A2H1QUGX0SOUMH
text: What is really awesome?

speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: We can help! This program that we are doing right now on MTURK allows us to donate some of our earnings to Save the Children. It is such a simple and easy way to make an impact if one wanted to.

speaker: A2H1QUGX0SOUMH
text: What percent of donations go to staff, administrative costs, etc.?

speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: 9 of every 10 dollars goes directly to children in need! So only 10% to administrative costs. The other thing is that we can help a child by donating the cost of a candy bar!

speaker: A2H1QUGX0SOUMH
text: How is the money distributed? Who precisely is performing the relief help?

speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: Volunteers provide the relief work through a variety of programs and emergency aid. The money is distributed where it is needed most - so if there is an emergency more money will go there. But there is a question that I would like to ask you.

speaker: A2H1QUGX0SOUMH
text: Go ahead, ask.

speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: Would you be willing to donate $0.20 to the relief work if I match the donation from this Mturk task? Together we can make a difference!

speaker: A2H1QUGX0SOUMH
text: Yes, that would be OK.

speaker: AAUZ7C9UH8UZV
text: Awesome! You are the best!
